collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: Watching an elder mend a net, an apprentice asks whether people in distant lands also grow old.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching an elder mend a net, an apprentice asks whether people in distant lands also lose strength, gain experience, and wonder where the years went.

text_only.reason: "experience" / "skill" in the everyday sense (what a person has lived through or can do), not a skill gain

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The apprentice imagines grandchildren learning an old song; the elder teaches the real song at once.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The elder notes that some people have no children and still deserve friendship and care.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Healers speculate about specialized houses and tools that might help people move or hear.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Someone worries that specialized care could separate elders from familiar places; no one declares one arrangement best.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The elder says being listened to matters more than being praised for wisdom.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The elder laughs and says not every old person is wise; the apprentice makes a note of that too.
